copy.tagline_en: Greet users with a friendly message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a simple way to say hello

howto.what: 启用该技能后，Claude 会以友好、温暖的语气向用户打招呼，并询问今天能提供什么帮助。
howto.when: 技能未说明自动触发条件，且标注 disable-model-invocation: true（不自动调用），需用户主动选择使用；典型场景是会话开场或要求问候时。

say.text: 你好，请友好地跟我打个招呼。
say.note: Claude 会发出友好问候并询问如何帮忙。

say.text: 嗨，用 hello 技能向我问好。
say.note: Claude 按技能定义回应问候。

say.text: 请用温暖的语气问候我今天过得怎么样。

howto.what_en: When this skill is enabled, Claude greets the user warmly and asks how they can help today.
howto.when_en: No automatic trigger is specified; it is marked as not auto-invoked, so the user must select it manually, typically for an opening greeting.

say_en.text: Hi, please greet me in a friendly way.
say_en.note: Claude will greet warmly and ask how to help.

say_en.text: Hey, greet me using the hello skill.
say_en.note: Claude responds per the skill definition.

say_en.text: Please warmly greet me and ask about my day.
